title: 目标视觉效果的差分烟雾测试
summary: 当渲染链可能在返回成功的同时静默缺失目标效果时，使用有/无该效果的受控输出进行像素/区域差分，证明效果真的进入最终渲染结果。
scenarios: subtitle-rendered frame vs no-subtitle control frame
expected glyph/overlay region has non-zero visual delta
constraints: A process return code alone does not satisfy this test.
The control pair should differ only in the capability under test where practical.
Thresholds must tolerate encoding/render noise without accepting zero-effect output.
